answered.sql: SELECT C.FirstName, C.LastName FROM Chefs C JOIN Languages L ON C.LanguageID = L.LanguageID WHERE L.LanguageName = 'English' UNION SELECT S.FirstName, S.LastName FROM Servers S JOIN Languages L ON S.LanguageID = L.LanguageID WHERE L.LanguageName = 'English'

candidates.meaning: Show the chefs and servers who speak English.
candidates.sql: SELECT C.FirstName, C.LastName, S.FirstName, S.LastName FROM Chefs C JOIN Languages L ON C.LanguageID = L.LanguageID JOIN Servers S ON S.LanguageID = L.LanguageID WHERE L.LanguageName = 'English'

candidates.meaning: Show the chefs and servers who have English as their language.
candidates.sql: SELECT C.FirstName, C.LastName FROM Chefs C JOIN Languages L ON C.LanguageID = L.LanguageID WHERE L.LanguageName = 'English' UNION SELECT S.FirstName, S.LastName FROM Servers S JOIN Languages L ON S.LanguageID = L.LanguageID WHERE L.LanguageName = 'English'

candidates.meaning: Show the chefs and servers who are hired in restaurants that serve English-speaking clients.
candidates.sql: SELECT C.FirstName, C.LastName FROM Chefs C JOIN ChefRestaurants CR ON C.ChefID = CR.ChefID JOIN Restaurants R ON CR.RestaurantID = R.RestaurantID WHERE R.Name IN (SELECT R.Name FROM Restaurants R JOIN ServerRestaurants SR ON R.RestaurantID = SR.RestaurantID JOIN Servers S ON SR.ServerID = S.ServerID JOIN Languages L ON S.LanguageID = L.LanguageID WHERE L.LanguageName = 'English')

candidates.meaning: Show the chefs and servers who are associated with restaurants where English is spoken.
candidates.sql: SELECT C.FirstName, C.LastName FROM Chefs C JOIN ChefRestaurants CR ON C.ChefID = CR.ChefID JOIN Restaurants R ON CR.RestaurantID = R.RestaurantID WHERE R.Name IN (SELECT R.Name FROM Restaurants R JOIN ServerRestaurants SR ON R.RestaurantID = SR.RestaurantID JOIN Servers S ON SR.ServerID = S.ServerID JOIN Languages L ON S.LanguageID = L.LanguageID WHERE L.LanguageName = 'English')

candidates.meaning: List chefs and servers who speak English.
candidates.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Chefs WHERE LanguageID = (SELECT LanguageID FROM Languages WHERE LanguageName = 'English') UNION SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Servers WHERE LanguageID = (SELECT LanguageID FROM Languages WHERE LanguageName = 'English')
